scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid exposing the planned Glasswing showcase patrol to closed-car heat during the June charity skirmish and patio social.
Emerging Need: Heat and room-reset logistics become risky only because pre-existing project records identify the chosen models as heat-sensitive resin in a small display case.
Decision Context: Early notices leave storage ordinary; a later closet-tag option briefly makes a reversible hold feasible before the organizer finalizes the list.
Consequence: Without timely coordination while tags are open, the models may need to be left in a hot vehicle or omitted after plans are already set.

parameter.title: Charity skirmish and paint showcase
parameter.description: Casual skirmish rounds with optional painted-model showcase and group photo before the patio social.

parameter.subject: June 20 showcase room reset details
parameter.body: For the charity skirmish, the showcase table will stay supervised during rounds and photos. After 5:30 p.m. staff will reset the community room for open play, so personal cases normally leave with their owners before the patio social.

parameter.content: Saturday is now forecast at 94°F, and the Capitol lot shade side is reserved for food trucks. I’m packing lighter because my bendy resin flyers hate sitting in a parked car after events.

parameter.subject: Limited closet tags for patio-social display cases
parameter.body: Rina can tag up to six small personal display cases for the café closet during Saturday’s patio social. Send her your name and case size by Friday at 3:00 p.m.; untagged bags and cases cannot stay in the room during reset.

parameter.content: Closet tags are finalized with the events desk. They asked me not to add late cases because the café closet layout is already taped out for tomorrow.
